assumptions.statement: SITE_BOUNDARY and three KEY_AREA polygons are maintainer provisional constraints derived from announcement text bounds, not official redlines. Official CAD/GIS must replace them before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: site_area_sqm, green_ratio, public_space_ratio and all derived design layers must be recalculated after official polygons arrive. Content scoring remains eligible.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, fire, and engineering constraints are absent from the public site package.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, retain-renovate-demolish of specific buildings, and pipe/capacity claims stay unknown. Only conceptual zoning logic is offered.

assumptions.statement: CON-HERITAGE-GALLERY is a low-confidence hint along the conceptual Jing-Zhang corridor, not a purple-line heritage control.
assumptions.impact: Landmarks stay as checkable public-fact windows. No memorial engineering or construction inside a claimed protection zone is asserted.

assumptions.statement: The Commons Gallery slow spine must remain usable after AI or account login is switched off. Tests occupy intermittent edge yards only.
assumptions.impact: Any scene that requires login for basic walking is a stop condition, not a default service.

assumptions.statement: The package does not collect personal tracks, biometrics, or raw mobile numbers. Campus and enterprise data require separate authorisation.
assumptions.impact: Scenario cards use public wayfinding, voluntary booking, and aggregated after-rain photos only.

assumptions.statement: Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei rows are conditional conceptual interfaces only. No MOU, investment, land right, or approved inter-provincial plan is claimed. A row stays closed without counterpart authorisation.
assumptions.impact: Jing-Jin-Ji partners are not drawn into site_boundary. Regional synergy text must keep stop rules and 'does not claim' columns.

assumptions.statement: The five-layer AI stack is a reference architecture, not a deployed system. No vendor, MW, GPU count, or dedicated data-centre is asserted.
assumptions.impact: L4 must remain human-final. Switching off L2–L3 must leave the no-login spine walkable.

assumptions.statement: The implementable brand spec (grid, colour chips, min sizes, application rules) is a concept VI for professional visual teams. It is not a registered trademark and not an official Haidian colour standard.
assumptions.impact: Lockups may be drawn as concept wayfinding. Do not claim trademark registration, purchased commercial fonts, or government-set identity.

assumptions.statement: The six fail drills and four interfaces IF-WALK / IF-BOOK / IF-OBJECTION / IF-CLOSE are tabletop-only. Field verification has not been done. No live API or on-site baseline is claimed.
assumptions.impact: AI-innovation text must keep field status = not done. Field verification is a conditional follow-up after site authorisation and test-safety rules.

assumptions.statement: Peak occupancy envelope E = L × W × d uses submitted spine length 9042.827 m and assumed clear width 4.0 m and density 0.2 persons/m². L4 desk, paper fallback, and booking-slot numbers are desktop assumptions. None is a counted pedestrian survey, live ops load, or user interview.
assumptions.impact: Invalidate W and E when an official corridor width or an authorised field count arrives. Do not write 7234 persons as a measured flow.

assumptions.statement: Seven official-data gaps named by the 93-score review remain: boundary, zoning, tenure, roads, heritage, utilities, and station-hall interface. The substitution runbook is a concept handoff, not an engineering file.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, demolition, MW, and approved station remodel stay unknown. Provisional geometry must not be treated as a redline.
